clusters.title: Scout only: DSV4 unified fp8 decode no longer returns NaN for an empty segment — 3/3 mi35x lanes, `aiter-caused`

details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]` From my own log grep (no per-job analysis exists for these jobs), `test_empty_segment_comes_back_nonfinite` fails with `assertTrue(torch.isnan(got[1]).any())` → `False is not true` on both attempts.

Sister baseline (default aiter `e7d2453f`, no override) passed the same file: [rocm10 shard 1](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38661136204/job/116182473921) at [`c891c5c7`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/c891c5c7ca5c1bf2229ee3020074514f86cb60f6) (31/31 files) and [rocm720 shard 1](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38608694530/job/116006233586) (31/31 files).

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[MEDIUM]` `decode_fp8_2buff` calls `aiter.mla.mla_decode_fwd_v4_nm` (`unified_kv_kernels/runtime.py:318`). The override [`4eb7dcac`](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/commit/4eb7dcac7e5f5abf566246534809644f73f07b49) changes how that asm kernel handles an all-sink denominator. **Disconfirming**: 8 sglang commits separate the baseline from the Scout SHA, but none touches `unified_kv_kernels`. The test's docstring says production builders never produce empty segments, so the impact may be limited to this guard test.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ❌ none found (searched `unified_fp8_decode`, `empty_segment`). **Suggested triage**: run this file on MI355 with `AITER_COMMIT_OVERRIDE=4eb7dcac` and with the new pin `2bb549102`, and bisect the aiter range if it reproduces.
